text: You are on the support-desk app in this directory. Customers come back to the order desk in later requests, often served by another server process. Make `orderAgent` conversations resumable by session id: the first request starts one with `orderAgent.chat()` and `send(message)` and reads the `sessionId` from the response; a later request, in a new process, continues it with `orderAgent.loadChat({ sessionId })` and `send(message)`. A customer who said "My order is A-1001." can then ask "What is the status of my order?" and get A-1001's status, and two customers' conversations never mix. Keep the existing flows and their exports. Don't change `package.json` or add dependencies.
